explanation: In the 1944 play, three dead strangers discover that hell is simply a room where they must face each other forever. It opened in Paris while the city was still under German occupation.

claims.text: Jean-Paul Sartre wrote Huis clos (No Exit), which contains the line 'Hell is other people' ('L'enfer, c'est les autres').
Camus, Beckett and Ionesco did not write Huis clos.
Huis clos was first performed in Paris in 1944, during the German occupation.
In Huis clos, three dead characters are shut in a room in hell together.
